statement: The drag area settles on the base mesh: its iterative uncertainty over the last 100 iterations is at most 1% of its mean

mechanism.how: aero.converged solves the base mesh with simpleFoam and reads the drag area's history from forceCoeffs: U_I = (max - min) / 2 over the last window (ITTC 7.5-03-01-01). The same run writes the fields the pictures draw
